changes.title: Biome ground
items: The ground cover and the scattered rocks and ruins now match their biome too: red sandstone in the badlands, pale sandstone in the south, black basalt in the volcanic east, frosty grey in the north

changes.title: Other bedrooms
items: The other two bedrooms are as big as hers, their furniture under dust sheets for now; stand at a locked door to peek in

changes.title: Ley exit
items: The ley line leaves the speakers' ring in a wide sweep, as round as its other turns, not a tight hook
